accounts.enterprise-description: If you are using GitHub Enterprise at work, sign in to it to get access to your repositories.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose which language the application uses for its interface. New or edited translations are picked up right away, no restart needed.
language.noMatch: None of your system languages ({languages}) has a translation yet, so the interface stays in English.
language.editorHint: Translate any string, or add a language of your own.
language.folderHint: You can also drop JSON files into {path} and reload.
language.confirmResetAll: This deletes every translation you have added. This cannot be undone.

integrations.copilot-description: Experience agent-driven development built natively on GitHub.

git.default-branch-heading: Default branch name for new repositories
git.default-branch-change: You may want to change it due to different workflows, or because your integrations still require the historical default branch name of
git.edit-global-config-link: edit your global Git config file
git.hooks-load-env: Load Git hook environment variables from shell
git.hooks-load-env-description: When enabled, GitHub Desktop will attempt to load environment variables from your shell when executing Git hooks. This is useful if your Git hooks depend on environment variables set in your shell configuration files, a common practice for version managers such as nvm, rbenv, asdf, etc.
git.hooks-shell-label: Shell to use when loading environment
git.hooks-cache-env-description: Cache hook environment variables to improve performance. Disable if your hooks rely on frequently changing environment variables.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Allows the display of notifications when high-signal events take place in the current repository.
notifications.grant-permission-hint: You need to <link>grant permission</link> to display these notifications from GitHub Desktop.
notifications.permission-denied: <icon/> GitHub Desktop has no permission to display notifications. Please, enable them in the <link>Notifications Settings</link>.
notifications.configure-hint: Make sure notifications are {verb} for GitHub Desktop in the <link>Notifications Settings</link>.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.underline-description: When enabled, GitHub Desktop will underline links in commit messages, comments, and other text fields. This can help make links easier to distinguish.
accessibility.show-diff-check-marks: Show check marks in the diff
accessibility.show-diff-check-marks-description: When enabled, check marks will be displayed along side the line numbers and groups of line numbers in the diff when committing. When disabled, the line number controls will be less prominent.

advanced.repository-indicators: Show status icons in the repository list
advanced.repository-indicators-description: These icons indicate which repositories have local or remote changes, and require the periodic fetching of repositories that are not currently selected.
advanced.repository-indicators-off-description: Turning this off will not stop the periodic fetching of your currently selected repository, but may improve overall app performance for users with many repositories.
advanced.help-improve: Help GitHub Desktop improve by submitting
advanced.gcm-description-suffix: for private repositories outside of GitHub.com. This feature is experimental and subject to change.

prompts.always-stash-on-current-branch: Always stash and leave my changes on the current branch
